value: Devlin, A., Kossen, J., Goldie-Jones, H. and Yang, A. (2023). Global green hydrogen-based steel opportunities surrounding high quality renewable energy and iron ore deposits. Nature Communications 14, 2578. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-023-38123-2. Supplementary Information: devlin_2023_green-hydrogen-steel-opportunities-si_ncomms.pdf

Main article (14 pp) and SI (19 pp) read. Loaded: whole-plant levelised cost of steel ranges (islanded RE, 1 Mt/yr, 0% scrap; 2020 USD), lifetime, discount rate, residual process CO2 (derived sum); SI Table S10 energy/H2 per t DRI and EAF electricity by scrap share; SI Table S11 shaft-furnace and EAF capex; SI Table S9 alkaline electrolyser capex and efficiency for 2030/2040/2050 installations. Most SI technical parameters are reprinted from other works (tagged). Not loaded: country-level LCOS (Table S3 rows print without country labels in the PDF text; Figs 2-5 chart values), renewable/storage/fuel-cell costs and ore-preparation energies (other-values). Locator: main article printed page numbers; SI page numbers are printed and equal PDF pages. Traps: Table S11 prints capex units as "$/Mt rated capacity" (read as $/t-per-yr); HBI/CDRI heating printed as 152.78 MWh/t (implausible, not loaded); casting and CGH2 cost units ambiguous; LCOS includes RE generation and storage, ore and labour, so it is not a plant-gate cost; electrolyser efficiency basis (LHV/HHV) not stated.
